H01.description: cell_range indexes cell_offsets by the cell's raw index among all cells, but the offsets only cover valid Python code cells, so any notebook with Markdown or cell-magic cells before the target cell gets the wrong range (or None).

H02.description: Doc comment clarifying that cell_content_range takes the raw cell index.

H03.description: Test-module import added for the new regression test.

H04.description: Adds regression test for cell_range lookup by raw cell index.

H05.description: Adds a helper that looks up a cell's range by URI via the corrected Notebook::cell_range; no changed callers are shown, so its intent beyond supporting the D1 fix is unclear.

H06.description: Adds e2e test for cells after a cell-magic cell.
